name: Shuuka
author: Shuuka

sections.description:
The internet is full of impersonators. Anyone can claim your name, your face, and your brand. Most platforms let you collect links; Shuuka lets you take control of who you are.

Shuuka is the single source of truth for your online presence. It is your official, verified identity — impossible to fake, undeniable to your audience. With this plugin, you can host your official Shuuka identity card directly on your own domain, under your own terms.

Verified. Undeniable. Yours.

Stop sending your followers to a third-party link-in-bio service. Own your story. Own your presence.

Features

  • Official Identity Card: A stunning, high-performance embed of your verified Shuuka profile.
  • Smart Route Routing: Create direct, memorable paths to your socials (e.g., yoursite.com/official/instagram).
  • Instant Verification: Prove you are who you say you are with built-in trust signals.
  • Creator Analytics: Integrated support for Google Analytics and Facebook Pixel to track your real audience growth.
  • Privacy by Design: Fully GDPR compliant, respecting your followers’ trust while providing a seamless experience.

Support

For documentation and direct support, visit shuuka.com.
sections.installation:
Shuuka for WordPress is designed to be live in under 2 minutes.

  1. Install & Activate: Search for “Shuuka” in your WordPress dashboard and activate the plugin.
  2. Follow the Setup: Open the new Shuuka menu item. Our interactive onboarding guide will walk you through the connection.
  3. Connect Your Identity: Enter your Embed ID and Secret Key (found in Shuuka → Integrations → WordPress).
  4. Go Live: Choose your path (e.g., yoursite.com/official) and you’re ready.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my API credentials?

Log into your account at shuuka.com and navigate to Settings → Integrations → WordPress. Your Embed ID and Secret Key are generated there.

Is it mobile friendly?

Absolutely. Your identity card is designed to look perfect on every screen size, from mobile devices to high-resolution desktops.

Does it affect my site’s speed?

No. The plugin is lightweight and uses an optimized embed mechanism to ensure your site stays fast.
